name: mithilakitchen
description: Business management platform for MithilaKitchen — home-style food, Osman Nagar, Tellapur

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mk/shared && npm run build -w @mk/api && npm run build -w @mk/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mk/api" "npm run dev -w @mk/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mk/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mk/api && npm run typecheck -w @mk/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mk/shared && npm run test -w @mk/api
